name: Moby
description: Open source container engine behind Docker.
summary: AI is welcome if you disclose the tool and how much it did, and a human reads, edits and owns everything before posting, including issues, PR descriptions and replies. No AI attribution trailers in commits.

evidence.quote: Say what you used: Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, whatever, and roughly how much of the work it did, in the issue or PR description.
Whoever opens the PR signs off on it and owns it, no matter what wrote the first draft.
Anything AI helped produce (an issue, a PR description, a review reply, a code change) gets read and edited by a human before it goes out.
Using AI to draft a reply is fine, including to bridge a language gap. Posting raw, unreviewed output isn't.
